caption: The drawing depicts a woven basket that is oval in shape, featuring a tightly interlaced pattern of natural and brownish-yellow fibers. The basket is shallow, with the weaving lines highlighted in shades that move from light yellow to brown, emphasizing the basket's texture. Attached to the basket are two dark brown leather straps: one strap is looped over the basket and appears to have a metal buckle, while the other strap is secured to the side and trails off the edge. The rim of the basket is reinforced with thicker woven material, and there is a tassel-like accent of light fibers attached at one end. The background is a plain, light beige color, providing contrast to the basket's details.
title: Grain Basket
